newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivian unions call off general strike.
newsitem.headline: Bolivian unions call off general strike.

text.p: Bolivia's COB trade union confederation on Tuesday suspended its 6-day-old general strike, but called for more street protests and hunger strikes against a controversial land bill.
Interior Minister Carlos Sanchez Berzain said he was glad the COB had ended the strike: "What we asked the COB for was to reflect and that it should take the path of dialogue and consensus."
But COB spokesman Lucio Gonzalez said the unions were merely altering their strategy of resistance to the bill.
"This does not mean the workers are dropping their fight against the law," Gonzalez said

Bolivia's Congress is still considering the government's land bill, which will grant powers to supervise land use and if necessary to seize control of property. The bill has aroused fierce opposition among peasants and farmers.
The general strike had had little effect on business.
